note: Open-source projects read structurally, one a day. Each entry names the exact version examined and ships a runnable re-cut of one seam.

title.zh: 第二種 host 介面沒有推翻那個想法，它推翻了那個欄位
title.en: The second host interface did not break the idea. It broke the field.

summary.zh: mssp-d-001 要的第一項驗證：找第二種 host 介面的改名，看同一份記錄能不能描述它。`logging.warn` → `warning` 的 host 是「類別與模組上的屬性存取」，沒有任何註冊表會去讀一列映射，所以舊名字必須是一個真的可呼叫物。量到：**三份手寫複本**（`Logger.warn`、`LoggerAdapter.warn`、模組級 `warn`），全部委派而非重寫，stacklevel 全是 2，而且**彼此沒有漂移**（量的，不是假設的）。三通道觀察器下：output 相同、return 相同、**warnings 不同**——舊名字多發一個 DeprecationWarning。所以別名成立；而 mssp-d-001 草案的 `allowed_deltas` 寫成點分欄位路徑（`meta.deprecated`）**描述不了它**，因為這裡唯一被允許的差異在一個通道上，不在物件的欄位上。修正是：`allowed_deltas` 要命名觀察器底下的**觀察**，而觀察器要列出自己的通道；欄位路徑只是觀察的一種。
summary.en: The first validation mssp-d-001 asked for. logging.warn → warning has a host interface of attribute access on a class and a module — no registry reads a mapping, so the old name must be a real callable. Measured: three hand-written copies, all delegating rather than reimplementing, all using stacklevel 2, and not drifted from each other. Under a three-channel observer, output and return are identical and warnings differ by one DeprecationWarning. The alias holds — and the draft schema's dotted field paths cannot say so, because the permitted difference is a channel rather than a field of an object. The amendment: allowed_deltas must name observations under a named observer, and a field path is one kind of observation rather than the only kind.

title.zh: CPython 的 json 早就在跑身分測試——而它的答案取決於你問哪一種相同
title.en: CPython's json has been running the identity test for twenty years — and its answer depends on which sameness you ask about

summary.zh: `json` 有一個 C 加速器 `_json` 跟一份純 Python 後備，整個模組的結構就是為了「這東西可以不在」。對它跑身分測試：**12 個值字串完全相同、12 個輸入的錯誤類別完全相同、而 12 個錯誤訊息裡有 1 個不同**（`"\x"` 的欄位與是否指名那個字元）。所以「加速器不是結構性的」在「同一個值」這個判準下為真，在「同一則訊息」這個判準下為偽——跟範例 007 是同一件事，只是這份程式碼比那個發現早了二十年。第二個發現：關掉加速器比看起來難，`make_scanner = c_make_scanner or py_make_scanner` 在 import 時就跑完了，我第一次量的是 C 跟 C 自己比並回報「相同」。
summary.en: json ships a C accelerator, _json, and a pure-Python fallback, and the module is shaped so the accelerator can be absent. Running the identity test on it: 12 value strings byte-identical, 12 inputs producing the same error class, and 1 of 12 error messages different — the column, and whether the offending character is named. So "the accelerator is not structural" is true under the witness "same value" and false under "same message", which is example 007's finding in code that predates it by two decades. Second finding: turning the accelerator off is harder than it looks, because make_scanner = c_make_scanner or py_make_scanner runs at import time; my first measurement compared C against C and reported them identical.

title.zh: 46 條規則裡只有一個碰到兄弟，而那一個是改名——MSSP 兩個模組在這裡互相牴觸
title.en: One of 46 rules reaches a sibling, and it is a rename — where two MSSP modules contradict each other

summary.zh: 46 個規則檔、79 次向上取用共用核心、108 次取用套件，而**引用兄弟規則的只有 1 次**：`imports-first.js` require `./first` 再覆寫 meta 標成 deprecated。那不是規則去拿兄弟的能力，是改名時把舊門留著。問題在於 MSSP 自己：模組 02 禁止 TMS 引用兄弟 TMS，模組 06 要求「替代先於移除」，而別名單元滿足其中一條的方式就是違反另一條。順帶量到這個專案存在的理由——本站宣告 25 個套件、裝了 475 個、可 require 但未宣告 450 個。
summary.en: 46 rule files, 79 requires reaching up to the shared core, 108 requires of packages — and exactly one require of a sibling rule: imports-first.js pulls in ./first and overrides its meta with deprecated:true. That is not a rule reaching a sibling for a capability, it is a rename that kept the old door open. The problem is MSSP's own: module 02 forbids a TMS importing a sibling TMS and module 06 requires replacement before removal, and an alias unit satisfies one by violating the other. Measured alongside it, the condition this project exists to answer: this site declares 25 packages, has 475 installed, and can require 450 it never declared.

title.zh: marked 15.0.12：一個 use()，兩種相反的語意，由 key 的名字決定
title.en: marked 15.0.12: one use(), two opposite semantics, selected by a key name

summary.zh: Lexer 4 個方法、Parser 2 個、Renderer 21 個（每個 token 型別一個）——走訪很小、處理很寬，而且 new Marked() 真的隔離。但 marked.use() 收到 walkTokens 或 hooks 會累積、收到 renderer 會覆寫，三種情況回傳同一個值，呼叫端無法分辨自己觸發了哪一種，也沒有 API 可以問現在裝了什麼。本週第三個回傳值在每條路徑上相同的設定函式。
summary.en: Lexer has four methods, Parser two, Renderer twenty-one — a small walk and a wide treatment — and new Marked() genuinely isolates. But marked.use() accumulates for walkTokens and hooks while overwriting for renderer, returns the same value in all three cases, and offers no way to ask what is installed. The third configuration function this week whose return value is identical on every path.

title.zh: urllib.request 3.14.5：註冊表是對的，而綁定靠命名，於是打錯字的 handler 完全惰性
title.en: urllib.request 3.14.5: the registry is right, the binding is by name, and a misspelled handler is silently inert

summary.zh: OpenerDirector 只有 6 個方法、BaseHandler 只有 3 個，handler 是傳進去的——這正是 http.server 做不到的事。但註冊表靠掃描方法名稱建立：`data_open` 註冊成功，`data_opne` 註冊 0 個、回傳 None、不報錯，而 `htp_open` 會替一個不存在的協定註冊。能力用命名宣告，而命名沒有東西檢查。
summary.en: OpenerDirector has six methods and BaseHandler has three, and handlers are passed in — the thing http.server cannot do. But the registry is built by scanning method names: data_open registers, data_opne registers nothing and returns None without complaint, and htp_open cheerfully registers a scheme that does not exist. Capability is declared by naming, and naming has nothing checking it.

title.zh: logging 3.14.5：四個軸切得很對，然後一層便利 API 一次跨過全部四個
title.en: logging 3.14.5: four axes cut correctly, and one convenience layer that reaches across all four

summary.zh: 2,326 行，而 Logger／Handler／Formatter／Filter 是四個真正獨立的軸——Handler 持有 Formatter，Formatter 不認識 Handler，Filter 是單一方法協定，propagate 屬於 Logger 不屬於 Handler。這一則主要在說它為什麼對。漏處只有一個而且很精確：`logging.info()` 會在 root 沒有 handler 時偷偷呼叫 basicConfig，之後你自己的 basicConfig 就完全不做事、也不說。
summary.en: 2,326 lines, and Logger / Handler / Formatter / Filter are four genuinely independent axes — a Handler holds a Formatter, a Formatter knows no Handler, Filter is a one-method protocol, and propagate belongs to the Logger rather than the Handler. Most of this entry is why that works. The one leak is precise: logging.info() quietly calls basicConfig when the root has no handlers, after which your own basicConfig does nothing at all and says nothing about it.

title.zh: http.server 3.14.5：當擴充點是繼承，子集就無法單獨存在
title.en: http.server 3.14.5: when the extension point is inheritance, no subset can stand alone

summary.zh: 1,441 行，BaseHTTPRequestHandler 28 個方法。新增一個動詞的方式是繼承整個類別再命名一個 do_X，於是每個「子集」都是「全部 ＋ 一個方法」。handle_one_request 一個方法同時讀 socket、解析、用 getattr 分派、寫回應、記錄；log_message 寫死 sys.stderr。重切後 do_GET 的對應物不需要 socket 就能單獨測。
summary.en: 1,441 lines, 28 methods on BaseHTTPRequestHandler. Adding a verb means subclassing the whole thing and naming a method do_X, so every "subset" is the whole plus one method. handle_one_request reads the socket, parses, dispatches by getattr, writes the response and logs, all in one method; log_message is hardcoded to sys.stderr. After the re-cut, the equivalent of do_GET runs alone with no socket.

title.zh: commander 2.20.3：解析結果與宿主效果之間的那條縫
title.en: commander 2.20.3: the seam between a parse result and a host effect

summary.zh: 1,225 行、一個檔案、36 個原型方法，其中 8 處直接呼叫 process.exit()。解析錯誤是知識，終止行程是效果，2.x 把兩者焊在一起。上游後來在 v4 和 v7 分別畫出了同樣的兩條界線。
summary.en: 1,225 lines in one file, 36 prototype methods, 8 direct calls to process.exit(). A parse error is knowledge; terminating the host is an effect. 2.x fuses them. Upstream drew the same two boundaries itself, at v4 and v7.
